description: Land Acquisition - Parambe, Kegalle D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that a specific parcel of land is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides a detailed description of the land (location, extent, boundaries) and is published in the "PART III – LANDS" section. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and other property-related matters. While a government minister is named, the primary focus is on the land acquisition process, not on the minister's appointment or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
